equivalence_boundaries: Raw candidate_cells is a deterministic screening count, not a count of mathematically independent laws.
Crossing, orbital, free-fall, and baryonic dynamical clocks are one algebraic equivalence class under the frozen definitions.
Phase is inert outside the oscillatory families; threshold is inert inside the log-periodic family; fitted scalar coefficients absorb polarity.
Numerically identical components across parameter cells form one empirical equivalence class and may not be described as separate discoveries.
